messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated function-call failures for customer QuarryLane (dedicated-us-west-2). Error rate spiked to ~9% over last 5m. Affected route: /v1/toolcall/run. Sample error: \"UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xc3 in position 120\". thread_ts=2751234567
Alice Nguyen: ack. I'm on it — pulling logs from the dedicated pool now. Can someone check whether this is only QuarryLane or other dedicated tenants?
Ben Ramos: I'm seeing a lot of similar stacktraces in quarrylane-*-pod logs in us-west-2. grep on json.decoder and unicode errors returns ~120 hits in the last 10m.
Carla Ortiz: tagging cs, Eva — heads up to QuarryLane support. ETA for initial customer update?
Eva Chen: I'll draft a short note: \"We're investigating intermittent function-call failures affecting tool integrations in your dedicated environment. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.\"\nDmitri Petrov: quick hypothesis: we've had recent websocket frame size tweaks in the dedicated proxy, might be splitting multibyte UTF-8 sequences across frames. That would explain the utf-8 decode failures at the parser layer.
Alice Nguyen: good hypothesis. Ben, can you dump a few raw frames from the proxy for a failing request? Command I used: 
```kubectl exec -it proxy-pod -- /bin/sh -c "tcpdump -i any -w - 'tcp port 443 and host <quarry-pool-ip>' | strings | head -n 200"```
(not pretty, but it'll show fragments)
Ben Ramos: grabbed a sample. here's the decoded snippet (sanitized):
```
... 
\xE2\x82\xAC...
... UTF-8 sequence split: first frame ends with 0xE2 0x82, next frame starts with 0xAC ...
```
That looks like mid-codepoint splits.
Alice Nguyen: ok that aligns with Dmitri. The runtime's toolcall parser expects well-formed JSON/UTF-8 after reassembly. If fragmentation is happening earlier, the JSON decoder hits extra/invalid bytes.
Carla Ortiz: immediate mitigation options? Can we reassemble frames in the proxy or add a lenient pre-parser in the runtime?
Dmitri Petrov: quick patch: enable lenient UTF-8 rejoin at the ingress side (C layer) or disable websocket fragmentation at the proxy. Short-term I can toggle the proxy config to set `proxy_buffering off` and `proxy_http_version 1.1` + `proxy_set_header Connection ""` for the dedicated pool to avoid chunking. Risk: small throughput hit.
Alice Nguyen: let's do it as a 1-click mitigation. Ben, can you stage a proxy config change for quarrylane's dedicated pool and roll to one rack first? Use canary: quarrylane-proxy-rc-1
Ben Ramos: starting canary roll now. kubectl apply -f s3://configs/dedicated/quarrylane/proxy/no-frag-canary.yaml
deploy-bot: deploy started: quarrylane-proxy-no-frag-canary (rollout id=rb-8842). Canary target: proxy-usw2-rack-3.
Ben Ramos: canary up. Running smoke tests against /v1/toolcall/run with a corpus that previously failed.
Ben Ramos: smoke results: 45 failing calls -> 0 failing calls on the canary. Error rate dropped to ~0.3% (likely unrelated flakiness).
Alice Nguyen: excellent. Roll to remaining proxies in pool, 2-minute stagger. Ben proceed.
Ben Ramos: rolling to rest of pool... rolling... finished. deploy-bot: rollout succeeded: quarrylane-proxy-no-frag (id=rb-8842).
Alice Nguyen: monitoring metrics now. I'll open a short-lived alert suppression for noisy downstream alarms and update the incident channel.
Carla Ortiz: hold on customer comms until we confirm stable for 15m. Draft note: \"We've deployed a proxy config change to prevent websocket frame fragmentation affecting function-call payloads. We observed error rates drop from ~9% to <1% after the change. We're monitoring and will follow up with a root cause and a permanent fix.\" 
Eva Chen: sent initial update to QuarryLane: \"Mitigation deployed. We are monitoring; next update in 30 minutes.\" Customer replied: \"Thanks — impact started 10:20am PST, toolcall integrations failing for internal workflows. Please keep us posted.\"
Dmitri Petrov: initial root-cause thinking: an optimization shipped last week modified proxy write buffer thresholds; under certain payload sizes and exact byte boundaries it produced fragmented frames that split UTF-8 multibyte sequences. Parser doesn't tolerate partial codepoints before reassembly in our runtime because we stream-parse chunks.
Alice Nguyen: long-term fix options: 1) revert optimization in proxy (conservative), 2) add reassembly at proxy layer for websocket frames, 3) make runtime parser tolerant to split codepoints (best compatibility). We should pick 2 + 3 as long-term: proxy reassembly plus parser robustness.
Carla Ortiz: created incident ticket INC-2026-485 in PagerDuty and a short postmortem draft in ops-confluence. Assigning owners: Dmitri for parser robustness (P1), Ben for proxy config audit & safe revert plan (P1), Carla for customer comms & postmortem (P2).
Alice Nguyen: handoff to Ben for post-deploy monitoring and long-term work coordination. I'll remain available for escalations. Ben, you own until T+2h.
Ben Ramos: acknowledged. First follow-up: audit all dedicated pool configs that had the buffer tweak. I'll run a grep across configs: `grep -R "write_buffer_size" /configs/dedicated | wc -l` and share results.
Ben Ramos: quick stats: 6 pools had the tweak in us-west-2, 2 pools in eu-central. We'll schedule audits.
Carla Ortiz: action items: - [x] Deploy canary mitigation to QuarryLane pool - [ ] Confirm stable for 30m - [ ] Postmortem draft - [ ] Customer RCA + timeline - [ ] Backfill changelog for buffer tweak
Alice Nguyen: metrics check: last 5m error rate for QuarryLane is 0.6%. 0.6% > baseline but well below outage threshold. Logging shows very few decoder errors.
Eva Chen: customer asked for ETA on permanent fix. Suggested ETA window: 5 business days for parser patch + 2 weeks for proxy change across all pools. Customer accepted initial timeline.
Dmitri Petrov: I'll start a branch for parser tolerance: `git checkout -b tolerant-utf8-parser` and add tests for split multibyte sequences. Example unit test I added: 
```
input_chunks = ["{\"tool\":\"proc\",\"args\": [\"price: ", "\xE2\x82", "\xAC 99\"]}"]  # euro sign split
assert parse_stream(input_chunks).args[0].endswith("€ 99")
```
Will open PR with draft today.
Ben Ramos: I'll create a config rollback playbook and a smoke test matrix for any future buffer tweaks.
Alice Nguyen: thanks team. We'll keep this thread updated. If anyone sees regression or other tenants affected, ping immediately.
Ben Ramos: quick note — during the canary we also saw one unrelated 502 spike (short-lived). Tracked to upstream auth service timeout, not related. Documented in the incident ticket.
deploy-bot: alert suppression enabled for route /v1/toolcall/run (quarrylane) until 2751235267. suppression_id=sup-9921
Alice Nguyen: last check, error rate holding at 0.5% for 10m. I'll move this to 'mitigated' and Ben will continue with follow-ups.
Carla Ortiz: thanks. I'll notify CS to schedule an RCA call with QuarryLane next week.
Ben Ramos: taking the owner role — will update with audit results and PR links.
Alice Nguyen: handing off to Ben. Incident status: MITIGATED — customer impact reduced, workaround deployed. End of active oncall for me.
Ben Ramos: acknowledged, will post follow-ups here.
Carla Ortiz: closing note for ops: please ensure the postmortem covers telemetry gaps that made detection slower and include suggested automated test for frame fragmentation in staging harness.
Alice Nguyen: closing thread for active ops. If anything pops, reopen. Thanks everyone.
